ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS — TERMLY EXAM #17
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In the number 3541, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 4
   C. 10
   D. 40

2. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 50
   B. 49
   C. 7
   D. 14

3. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 82
   C. 9
   D. 81

4. What is 8 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 16
   B. 65
   C. 0
   D. 64

5. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 8 cm and 15 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 23
   B. 19
   C. 7
   D. 17

6. In the number 3141, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 400
   C. 40
   D. 4

7. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 26
   C. 170
   D. 169

8. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 42
   C. 12
   D. 36

9. What is 8 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 72
   B. 17
   C. 1
   D. 73

10. Solve for x: x + 7 = 11. (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 4
   C. 7
   D. 5

11. What is 8 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 12
   C. 32
   D. 33

12. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 121
   B. 11
   C. 122
   D. 22

13. What is 8 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 14
   C. 48
   D. 2

14. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 36
   C. 81
   D. 90

15. What is 4 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 13
   C. 12
   D. 7

16. What is 4 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 20
   C. 9
   D. 21

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

18. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

19. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

20. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

21. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

22. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
